title: Ascending chain and maximal condition for submodules of a finite module over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $M$ a finitely generated $A$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Then (1) every increasing sequence $N_1\subseteq N_2\subseteq\dots$ of $A$-submodules of $M$ is eventually constant: there is $n$ with $N_m=N_n$ for all $m\ge n$; (2) every nonempty set $\Psi$ of $A$-submodules of $M$ has a maximal element: some $N\in\Psi$ such that no $N'\in\Psi$ satisfies $N\subsetneq N'$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00IK (lemma-Noetherian-basic), third assertion (ascending chain condition for submodules of a finite module over a Noetherian ring); the maximal-element form (2) is the equivalent formulation used for Noetherian induction (the proof of 00IK omits the equivalence of the ascending chain condition with finite generation of all submodules)
